main.summary: Seekable read-only stream window over a bounded region of an existing source stream.

field.name: Source
field.summary: The underlying source stream that backs the bounded window.

field.name: Origin
field.summary: The absolute byte offset in the source stream where the bounded window begins.

field.name: WindowLength
field.summary: The length in bytes exposed by the bounded window.

field.name: LeaveOpen
field.summary: True when disposing the wrapper should not dispose the underlying source stream.

field.name: disposed
field.summary: Tracks whether the stream has been disposed.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a bounded read-only view over a seekable source stream.
constructor.param: The byte offset where the window begins.
The number of bytes exposed by the window.
True to leave the source stream open when this wrapper is disposed.

property.name: CanRead
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the underlying source stream supports reading.

property.name: CanSeek
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the underlying source stream supports seeking.

property.name: CanWrite
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether this wrapper supports writing.

property.name: Length
property.summary: Gets the bounded window length in bytes.

property.name: Position
property.summary: Gets or sets the current position within the bounded window.

method.name: FlushAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously flush the underlying source stream.
method.returns: A task that completes when the underlying flush operation completes.

method.name: Read
method.summary: Read bytes from the bounded window.
method.param: Destination buffer for the read bytes.
Start offset in the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.
method.returns: The number of bytes read from the bounded window.

method.name: ReadSpan
method.summary: Read bytes into the supplied span from the bounded window.
method.param: Destination span for the read bytes.
method.returns: The number of bytes read from the bounded window.

method.name: ReadAsync
method.summary: Asynchronously read bytes from the bounded window.
method.param: Destination buffer for the read bytes.
Start offset in the destination buffer.
Maximum number of bytes to read.
method.returns: A task that completes with the number of bytes read.

method.name: ReadAsyncMemory
method.summary: Asynchronously read bytes into the supplied memory from the bounded window.
method.param: Destination memory for the read bytes.
method.returns: A task-like value that completes with the number of bytes read.

method.name: Seek
method.summary: Change the position within the bounded window.
method.param: Reference point used to obtain the new position.
method.returns: The new position within the bounded window.

method.name: WriteAsync
method.returns: A task that faults because writing is not supported.

method.name: WriteAsyncMemory
method.returns: A task-like value that faults because writing is not supported.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Dispose the bounded stream wrapper and optionally the underlying source stream.
method.param: True when called from deterministic disposal; otherwise false.
